description: This file defines the AdjustLoanTransactionCommandStrategy class, which implements a command pattern for adjusting loan transactions via a REST API. It parses URL parameters from a batch request, interacts with the LoanTransactionsApiResource to perform the adjustment, and constructs a BatchResponse.

classes.name: AdjustLoanTransactionCommandStrategy
classes.description: Implements the CommandStrategy interface to adjust a loan transaction by invoking the corresponding API resource, handling URL path parameters and request/response mapping.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a BatchRequest to adjust a loan transaction, extracting path and query parameters, calling the API resource, and preparing a BatchResponse.
